# Headshots by Marie

> A private headshot and portrait studio in Gilbert, Arizona, led by French photographer Marie Feutrier, serving the greater Phoenix metro. Known for unhurried sessions, hands-on coaching, and an editorial eye.

## About

Headshots by Marie is a private photography studio owned by Marie Feutrier, specializing in headshot and portrait photography for professionals, executives, actors, and personal brands. Marie is a French photographer who studied in Grenoble before building her studio in Arizona; her work has been featured in AD PRO and Bold Journey. She books no more than three sessions a day, so no session is rushed and no one is waiting after you. Named Best Photographer in Gilbert by Business Rate, three years running. The studio is located in Gilbert, Arizona, and serves clients throughout the Phoenix metro area including Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Queen Creek, Apache Junction, and Ahwatukee.

- [About Marie](https://headshotsbymarie.com/about/): who Marie is and how she works
- [Bio](https://headshotsbymarie.com/bio/): the full story, from France to a studio in the desert
- [The Studio](https://headshotsbymarie.com/the-studio/): inside the Gilbert studio, Broncolor lighting and hand-painted backdrops

## Services

- [Executive Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/executive-headshots/): polished portraits for CEOs, directors, managing partners, and senior leaders. Individual and team sessions available.
- [LinkedIn Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/linkedin-headshots/): professional profile pictures for LinkedIn and other professional platforms.
- [Actor Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/phoenix-actor-headshots/): commercial and theatrical headshots for SAG actors and aspiring talent.
- [Personal Branding Photography](https://headshotsbymarie.com/personal-branding/): portraits that show your professional brand and personality.
- [Corporate Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/corporate-headshots/): on-location company headshot programs for teams of all sizes, plus conference and event coverage.
- [Team Photography](https://headshotsbymarie.com/team-photography/): on-location corporate team headshots with consistent lighting and backdrops.
- [Podcast Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/podcast-headshots/): host photography for cover art, YouTube thumbnails, and guest media kits.
- [Glamour Portraits](https://headshotsbymarie.com/glamour-portraits-phoenix/): editorial glamour portraits, magazine-style beauty, milestone, and pageant-ready photography.
- [ERAS Headshots](https://headshotsbymarie.com/eras-headshots/): headshots for medical residency applications, formatted to AAMC specs and delivered before your deadline.

## Studio Details

- **Location**: Gilbert, Arizona (25 minutes from downtown Phoenix)
- **Service Area**: Phoenix, Gilbert, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Chandler, Queen Creek, Apache Junction, Ahwatukee
- **On-Location**: Available anywhere in the Phoenix metropolitan area
- **Sessions**: Unlimited time, outfits, and backgrounds; no more than three sessions a day
- **Retouching**: Professional retouching included with every final image
